result.summary: The page mostly looks polished, but a few visual issues stand out: a loading spinner appears stuck over a restaurant image, some horizontally scrollable cards/categories are clipped at the right edge, and lower content is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the restaurant card content is already visible. This makes the card look stuck or partially failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image or card content has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/loading state before the image appears.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels are visibly clipped on the right edge, with partial pills/cards and truncated restaurant text visible.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, add clearer spacing or a fade/scroll affordance. If not intentional, adjust carousel width, padding, and item sizing so content does not appear accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card area, making the bottom content feel crowded and partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation height plus safe-area spacing so cards are not obscured behind the nav.
